name: BIM visibility metrics for synthetic image generation
description: A set of metrics and an evaluation framework to benchmark and improve Building Information Modeling (BIM) visibility in synthetic images used for computer vision-based progress tracking.
general_score_metric: visibility_score (composite of IoU and visibility heuristics)
reputation: A niche, research-focused benchmark with limited but growing recognition within construction-focused computer vision and synthetic-data communities.
notes: Domain-specific, synthetic-data benchmark; small/targeted scope for BIM visibility with potential sim-to-real gaps; non-LLM, primarily computer-vision metrics.
